request: 增加崩溃检测机制和崩溃代码显示
acceptance: Catch early first-party script failures, uncaught exceptions and unhandled rejections; show stable error code, incident ID, source position and redacted stack in a single independent nonmodal notice/detail viewer. Ignore expected aborts and ordinary image failures.

Bound and deduplicate reports; persist only safe metadata, never raw messages/stacks/secrets. Previous unclean tab termination is labelled uncertain. Locks hide diagnostics. No automatic reload, resend, cancellation or model calls.

Health checks use bounded timeout and consecutive failure threshold; offline/unreachable/restarted service remain distinct from confirmed JS/request panic. Pause probes in background/lock; detect real instance changes.

Server request panic has a stable diagnostic code/incident ID without exposing panic contents; preserve auth/CSP and streaming/hijack semantics. API failures report matching incidents without swallowing normal error handling.

Behavioral regressions, actual fault-injected isolated browser/server validation, native normal-runtime check, quick/full and authorized main/runtime/offline gates. Do not crash user production or original sessions.

requirements.summary: User asks crash detection and crash code display. Include diagnostic details, honest boundaries and independent UI, preserving drafts and unrelated sessions.

design.summary: Early independent global error/rejection/resource hooks, bounded safe-metadata storage, explicit detail/copy/reload actions; instance-aware foreground health probes and typed server panic replies. Existing diagnostics require debug mode and do not replace crash UI.

implementation.summary: Independent frontend monitor/CSS and focused behavioral checks implemented but not wired into production pages yet. Server panic/instance identity, UI entry/localization and actual fault browser checks remain.

release_authorization: Existing incremental main/push/local start.command/offline authorization; no version/tag/Release.
rollback: Preserve current5183a60 image/package and protected state. Revert only diagnostic frontend/health/recovery changes; no data migration.
handoff: Based on unmerged aurora096cf055. Aurora full session4595 is already running an isolated immutable source snapshot; do not reuse it for crash changes. Finish aurora gate on its branch after committing own crash work, then merge main back into this branch before crash release.
